_what_this_is: One entry per closed optimisation loop on a noise experiment. A loop is measured, changed ONE thing, re-measured. An entry without both a before and an after number is not a loop and does not belong here. Read by coverage.py.

_fields.dataset: the dataset it was measured on, and how many molecules
_fields.changed: the one thing that changed, in words
_fields.before: the number before, with its unit named
_fields.after: the number after, with its unit named
_fields.kept: true if the change stayed in the file, false if it was reverted
_fields.note: optional: what the number does not settle

loops.changed: the row weight ratio the repair applies, from 1.11-to-1 to 4-to-1
loops.before: a positive share of the clean-to-corrupted gap recovered in 3 of the 15 distances
loops.after: a positive share recovered in 13 of the 15 distances
loops.note: 4-to-1 against 10-to-1 split the 60 paired readings 30 to 30, so what this bought was leaving the weakest setting behind, not the choice between those two.

loops.changed: the representation the plain distance is computed in, from the esm2_cdr fallback to saprot
loops.before: best of the 15 distances, 0.2455 detection average precision
loops.after: best of the 15 distances, 0.2266 detection average precision
loops.note: The plain control improved from 0.2101 to 0.2221 and the forest proximity fell from 0.2455 to 0.1885, so the best distance in the run dropped. Reverted; the choice of base representation is the owner's, and changing it means changing pick_noise_base_rep for the whole suite.

loops.changed: the importance exponent matched to the distance metric rather than fixed at 0.5
loops.before: 0.2098 detection average precision, lightgbm_gain at exponent 0.5 under manhattan
loops.after: 0.2388 detection average precision, lightgbm_gain at exponent 1.0 under manhattan
loops.note: The matched exponent won 3 of the 4 scorer-and-metric pairs. Four paired readings behind each, so it is a direction. n12 still applies 0.5 under manhattan, which is the mismatched pairing.

loops.changed: built the similarity-objective hybrid space, which the file had never produced a number for
loops.before: no number: the experiment built four distances and its header said four
loops.after: 0.2182 detection average precision under manhattan, against 0.2045 for the prediction-objective hybrid and 0.2101 for the plain representation
loops.note: The two hybrid spaces share no identical reading, so they are genuinely different spaces. Four paired readings behind each comparison.

loops.changed: the flag rates swept, from 0.05/0.10/0.20 to 0.01/0.05/0.20, and the detectors from neighbor_residual and activity_cliff_aware to neighbor_residual and cross_val
loops.before: downweight best in 5 of 5 folds at 4 of 4 settings, +0.0047 rmse
loops.after: downweight best in 5 of 5 folds at 9 of 12 settings, +0.0069 rmse
loops.note: remove went from 0 of 12 settings positive to 2 of 12, both of those at the new 0.01 flag rate.

loops.changed: swept the correction strength instead of using one value
loops.after: downweight at a 4-to-1 row weight ratio, best in 5 of 5 folds, +0.0447 spearman against a 0.5985 baseline

loops.changed: added the hybrid and similarity-objective hybrid spaces beside the base representation
loops.before: nothing won in the hybrid space
loops.after: downweight best in 5 of 5 folds at 6 of 12 settings, +0.0041
loops.note: cross_val supplied every best setting on this dataset.

loops.changed: the reliability score for regression, from the previous scoring to the neighbour-mean deviation passed through weights_from_scores at a 4-to-1 ratio
loops.before: within 0.001 on both datasets, in their own metrics
loops.after: -0.0098 rmse on herg_ki; +0.0192 and +0.0367 spearman on flab_thermo_tresanco

loops.dataset: flab_thermo_tresanco, 672 antibodies, 448 per training fold, saprot, random forest, spearman
loops.changed: the injected dose, from the level 0.5 n07 runs to level 2.0, at the same one molecule in ten corrupted
loops.before: the clean-to-corrupted gap a recovery divides by, 0.0192 spearman against a clean score of 0.5985 spearman
loops.after: the same gap, 0.1639 spearman against the same clean score of 0.5985 spearman
loops.note: Measured over 3 scaffold-grouped folds and 3 noise draws. NOT applied: the injected level is the owner's to set and it is the axis the experiment is about. It is recorded because at level 0.5 the completed run on disk, at 2 folds and 1 noise draw, measured that gap as NEGATIVE -- clean 0.5775 spearman against corrupted 0.5847 -- so every recovery in its hybrid block came back undefined. Level 1.0 gives 0.0656 spearman and level 3.0 gives 0.2758. Doubling the corrupted share from one molecule in ten to one in five moved the gap from 0.0192 to 0.0225 spearman at level 0.5 and from 0.1639 to 0.1643 at level 2.0, so the dose is what damages the model and the count of corrupted molecules barely is.

loops.dataset: synthetic, 90 rows, 70 per training fold — a cost measurement, not a score
loops.changed: the iteration harness's n11 cuts rebound onto the two lists the loops actually read, and the extra-target list gated at the place the targets are built
loops.before: 28 downstream model fits per estimator per estimation space with one downstream model, and one Gaussian-process out-of-fold pass per (fold, draw, space)
loops.after: 10 downstream model fits per estimator per estimation space with one downstream model, and no Gaussian-process out-of-fold pass
loops.note: This settles nothing about which estimator to pair with which correction. The harness had declared these cuts since 2026-09-18 and they reached nothing: it rebound ALPHAS, an alias bound once at import that the result file reports and no loop reads, while the loops read SMOOTH_ALPHAS and WEIGHT_STRENGTHS; and it rebound EXTRA_TARGETS, which run() wrote into the result file while building both targets by hand. So a run under the harness reported two cuts it had not made and paid for a Gaussian process it had asked to drop. n11 still produced no result file on 2026-09-20 — every result store it reads raises StaleResultDB for a missing distance_metric column.

loops.dataset: flab_thermo_tresanco, 672 antibodies, 448 per training fold, saprot, random forest, spearman
loops.changed: how far a label moves toward its target, from the alpha of 0.5 that oof_smooth and gp_smooth run at to an alpha of 1.0, with the suspicion score rescaled the same way in both
loops.before: aiming at a Gaussian-process posterior mean, 0.4509 spearman; aiming at a LightGBM out-of-fold prediction, 0.4581 spearman; aiming at the mean label of the ten nearest molecules, 0.4331 spearman
loops.after: aiming at a Gaussian-process posterior mean, 0.4996 spearman; aiming at a LightGBM out-of-fold prediction, 0.4703 spearman; aiming at the mean label of the ten nearest molecules, 0.4552 spearman
loops.note: Three folds, one noise draw each, injected level 2.0, one molecule in ten given the wide error. Clean 0.5985 spearman, corrupted 0.4111, so the gap is 0.1874 spearman. The mean of three folds moves the right way for all three targets, but FOLD BY FOLD it is 7 of 9 paired readings, not 9: on the third fold moving the whole way LOST for the LightGBM target (0.4262 down to 0.3866 spearman) and for the neighbour mean (0.4076 down to 0.3951). Only the Gaussian-process target won on all three folds. The best single setting is gp_smooth moving the whole way, 0.4996 spearman and 47.2 percent of the gap, against 0.4509 and 21.2 percent at the half-way setting it runs at -- so the two model-based corrections coming last of seven in the completed run is the ranking of one alpha, not of the targets. WHAT IT DOES NOT SETTLE: for the neighbour-mean target, overwriting the flagged tenth outright scored 0.4829 spearman against 0.4552 for moving every label the whole way, so knn_smooth's shape is not beaten. And rescaling the suspicion score by its rank put the labels closest to clean on all three folds -- 7.12 to 7.69 label units against 10.85 to 12.95 for every other setting -- while recovering the least of the gap, so the correction that repairs the most labels is not the one that recovers the most score. NOT APPLIED: one dataset, one representation, one downstream model, one dose, and n18 already sweeps this same alpha over 0.25, 0.5 and 1.0 for exactly these two cleanups. WHY IT MOVES AT ALL: the Outlier condition is Huber contamination at lambda 3, so every training label carries an error and the flagged tenth carries one about three times wider -- 39.32 label units from clean on the 39 molecules flagged in fold 0 against 12.67 on the other 409, clean label standard deviation 10.12. Run cost 5999 seconds for the three folds on a machine at load 200 to 480.

loops.dataset: flab_thermo_tresanco, 672 antibodies, saprot, 2 scaffold-grouped folds, 1 corruption draw each, injected level 2.0, one molecule in ten corrupted
loops.changed: the fraction of the way a score-proportional correction moves a label, from 0.5 to 1.0, holding the correction's target fixed
loops.before: share of the 0.1939 spearman clean-to-corrupted gap recovered at 0.5: 25.9% for the gaussian-process target, 11.2% for the neighbour mean, 25.7% for the out-of-fold prediction
loops.after: at 1.0: 44.6%, 31.5% and 45.4% for the same three targets
loops.note: NOT applied: 2 folds and 1 draw each, and the folds took 1848 and 3757 seconds. Recorded because it refutes the reading that the min-max rescale was what held these corrections back. Replacing the raw score with its rank at the same 1.0, which makes that rescale the identity, LOST at all three targets: 26.5%, 19.3% and 23.1%. Both comparisons held at 3 of 3 targets across the first pass and the second. The TARGET matters less than it looked after one pass: at 1.0 the out-of-fold prediction (45.4%) and the gaussian process (44.6%) are within a point of each other, where after one pass they read 38.7% and 47.5%. Separately, the shape that moved labels closest to their clean values was not the shape that scored best -- rank at 1.0 cut the mean distance from a corrupted training label to its clean value from 15.05 label units to between 7.25 and 7.81 and still lost the held-out spearman to proportional at 1.0, which reached only 10.99 to 11.15 units. The gaussian process ran without importance-weighted kernel inputs. n18's STRENGTHS sweep is what would settle the alpha.

loops.changed: the fold's homology groups are handed to the detector that decides which labels are suspect, instead of being withheld
loops.before: 0.2845 detection average precision on held-out fold 0 and 0.2056 on held-out fold 1, groups withheld
loops.after: 0.3322 detection average precision on held-out fold 0 and 0.2387 on held-out fold 1, groups given
loops.note: Two paired passes, one corruption draw, one dataset, one representation (esm2_cdr, which is what pick_noise_base_rep falls back to here). Giving the groups won both passes, by 0.0477 and by 0.0331 average precision, so the gain is larger than the difference between the two gains. Cross-checked by n20's own run the same night, which computed the same score with the groups withheld and wrote 0.2450 average precision averaged over its 2 passes at 30 corrupted of 336 training antibodies, against 0.2451 for the mean of the two withheld readings here. What it does not settle: whether the recipe the search then picks, or the held-out spearman, moves at all. n20's first result file, written that night, came back with its search scoring ONE candidate per fold, so the recipe could not move whatever the flag list said.

loops.dataset: flab_thermo_tresanco, 672 antibodies, 448 per training fold, esm2_cdr, random forest, spearman, 3 scaffold-grouped folds
loops.changed: the scale the four score-proportional corrections read a suspicion score on, from the raw score the correction min-max rescales itself to the molecule's position in the ordering
loops.before: over the 24 readings the two runs share for those four corrections, the cleaned model beat the uncleaned one on 24 of 72 folds; gp_smooth averaged -0.0093 spearman over its 6 settings
loops.after: 27 of 72 folds; gp_smooth averaged -0.0267 spearman over the same 6 settings
loops.note: Mixed and mostly worse, so the knob was removed rather than left beside the raw score. downweight improved, from winning 7 of 18 folds to 10 of 18; gp_smooth got clearly worse; label_smooth and oof_smooth did not move. The control held exactly: remove, knn_smooth and quantile_clip threshold at a quantile or read no score, and all 14 of their readings came back bit-identical across the two runs, while all 24 score-proportional readings moved. Measured in the base representation only -- both hybrid spaces were unavailable, see the note on the strength loop.

loops.dataset: flab_thermo_tresanco, 672 antibodies, 448 per training fold, esm2_cdr, random forest, spearman, 3 scaffold-grouped folds
loops.changed: nothing in the file: the existing strength grid was read out per correction, to settle whether moving a label all the way beats moving it a quarter of the way
loops.after: the strongest setting loses at every correction. label_smooth is best at alpha 0.25, 0.4492 spearman against 0.4185 at alpha 1.0. oof_smooth is best at alpha 0.5, 0.4651 against 0.4512 at alpha 1.0. gp_smooth is best at alpha 0.5, 0.4726 against 0.4705 at alpha 1.0. downweight is best at a 4-to-1 row weight ratio, 0.4823 against 0.4687 at 10-to-1
loops.note: The grid does not need extending above alpha 1.0; it may need extending below 0.25 for label_smooth. Only one setting of the 44 scored won every fold: gp_smooth at alpha 1.0 with the cross_val detector, 3 of 3 folds, 0.4590 to 0.4705 spearman. Two cautions. Both hybrid spaces were absent -- every stored search on disk is behind the distance_metric column commit 9c6f7d7 added, so this is the base representation alone. And the uncleaned score here is 0.4590 spearman where the earlier n18 entry on this dataset reads 0.5985, because pick_noise_base_rep has no ecfp4, pdv or blosum on an antibody set and falls back to esm2_cdr alphabetically, while the 0.5985 runs elsewhere in this ledger name saprot.

loops.dataset: flab_thermo_tresanco, 672 antibodies, 448 in fold 0's training block, saprot, 1280 features
loops.changed: weighted the Gaussian process's kernel inputs by each feature's lightgbm gain, which is what cut a Gaussian process's error by 29 percent in n21
loops.before: the posterior mean gp_smooth aims every label at spans 1.6899 label units across the 448 molecules and rank-correlates with the labels it was fitted on at -0.0234 spearman
loops.after: the same 1.6899 label units and the same -0.0234 spearman; the two posterior means differ by 0.00000000 label units, bit-identical
loops.note: THE WEIGHTING IS NOT THE FINDING. It reached the kernel and it was drastic -- lightgbm gives gain to only 361 of saprot's 1280 features, so 919 columns were multiplied by zero and both guards in GaussianProcessEstimator passed. Nothing changed because the process is not reading its inputs. Counted directly: the 448 molecules receive 3 DISTINCT posterior-mean values, 64.0567, 65.7113 and 65.7467 label units, and each is exactly the mean label of the inner fold that molecule was held out of -- inner fold 0 trains on 298 molecules whose mean label is 64.0567 and every molecule it held out received 64.0567. The fitted noise level is 22.7930 label units against a fitted-label standard deviation of 22.8228, so the process assigns all of the variance to noise and its posterior mean is its prior mean. So gp_smooth does not move a label toward what a Gaussian process predicts for that molecule, which is what n07's docstring says it does; it moves every label toward the mean label of its inner fold. It is shrinkage toward the mean under a model's name. This is one representation at 1280 features over 448 molecules, which is the regime where an isotropic RBF kernel flattens because every pair of molecules is nearly the same distance apart; whether a narrower feature set revives it is not measured.
